original.statement: The deprecated CLI flag `enable-remote-node-identity` has been removed and is no longer honoured.

decision.reason: [ev-b8b62ef806f0] says the deprecated flag `enable-remote-node-identity` has been removed. Under the canonical shape for a removed CLI flag, the exposed environments are those that still set the flag, which is cli-flag{--enable-remote-node-identity, set}. Both proposals give exactly this. The cited section context ([ev-f64f7c540c6d], [ev-91fac6720d6f]) lists other removals the same way and points to a broader or narrower condition for none of them. The Helm upgrade notes this item refers to are not among the excerpts, so no Helm values key can be named here as another place that sets the flag.
